d: Long, flowing honey-blonde hair with straight bangs and a soft texture. Bright azure eyes with a cheerful, wide-eyed expression. An adolescent appearance with a slender build. Wearing a white sailor cap with a black bow, a navy blue short-sleeved sailor collar cape with a black bow at the chest, and a white sleeveless high-waisted dress featuring a vertical row of dark buttons and a grey utility belt. Accessories include white fingerless gloves and a small grey mechanical turret held in one hand.
